card.name: Casual web text at sentence starts
card.fires_on: Sentence or clause boundaries in informal general web text, such as question openers like What or Why, a contraction 's, or a period or comma before a new thought. It is not tied to medical wording.

modes.label: Question openers
modes.description: Capitalized question words like What or Why that start a new headline or sentence.
modes.example: - What's the Longest Film Ever Made? -<< What>> Was the First Movie Sequel? -

modes.label: Informal punctuation and links
modes.description: Contractions, quotes, commas, periods or small words in casual commentary or opinion.
modes.example: missing the real story and it<<'s>> amazing how brain dead some people are,"

card.writes: It nudges toward casual, slangy words like shit, kinda, alot and stats, and away from formal words like presently and nevertheless.
card.plain: It marks informal chatty web writing, where slang is likely to come next.
